trust_decision.summary: sanitize-html decides per element whether to emit it (tag allowlist) and per attribute whether its URL value passes the scheme policy; at the pinned commit an allowed SVG SMIL animation element is emitted without regard to which attribute its attributeName retargets, so its values/from/to/by reach a link sink unchecked.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'URI-list scheme-policy bypass'; the only scheme-policy check is the allowedSchemesAppliedToAttributes/naughtyHref test here, so an engineer would first try to split `values` on ';' and check each entry at this line.
